style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, bright noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something huge crosses or fills the frame: the spit, a tag, the bucket, the goat's muzzle, the bell. Lens covered nine times; the grass never stops
camera_moves: wide; at 5.5 the flying tags carry the camera into a drifting macro of her eye; wide again at 9.6
character: a fluffy alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, mild and puzzled; copper bell; ears bare until 0.6
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, huge horns, square yellow pupils, chewing non-stop. HIS EARS ARE BARE — he ate every tag
props: TAGS all different: ORANGE round, big as her head; LIME small square; BLUE long narrow; a spray of TINY WHITE; RED round, twice the orange. Pictograms, no letters. BUCKET: red plastic
prop_continuity: only the goat takes tags off; his ears stay bare
environment: mountain pasture, wind-raked grass, blue sky, peaks
lighting: mountain noon, hard sun, crisp shadows

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: mild puzzled female voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 4.1-5.5 is ONE unbroken phrase, no break at 4.8; 5.5-6.7 ONE phrase, no break at 6.2; one stop only, 6.7-7.2; voiceless after 8.6
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a wet splat at 0.0, a clack on every tag, a bucket bang at 3.7, the bell at 4.1 and 6.7, a clang and snapping strap at 9.6

timeline.a: silent. Her head lunges forward and plasters the lens with a white glob: two frames solid white, then it runs down
the orange tag flies into the lens, blacks the frame, lands on her left ear; then she strides at the lens till her head fills it
the GOAT barges in from the right and snaps his jaw shut on the lime tag at the lens, blacking it out; she rocks back
silent. He hooks the bucket on a horn and FLINGS it into the lens: it fills the frame, drops away, the blue tag spilling out
she shakes her whole body like a wet dog; the long blue tag whips across the full width of frame twice
no break in her voice. The GOAT rams his chewing muzzle into the lens, fills the frame, pulls back with the lime tag in his teeth
the TINY WHITE tags burst at the camera and blank the frame; through the gap her eye swells to half the screen and blinks
no break. His lip peels the blue tag off her ear and FLINGS it into the lens, covering the frame; her head jerks after it
silent, the only stop. Both heads hold at the lens, jaws still; the bell swings hard, blurring edge to edge, a gust flattening the grass
she rears up, the coloured mass lifting with her from bottom to top of frame; the big red tag flies into the lens onto her right ear
silent. Her head slams down, the glob flies STRAIGHT INTO THE LENS, splatters the frame, then drains: it lands in the bucket
silent. The goat takes the cluster in his teeth and yanks; both heads come together at the lens
silent. The bell tears off, flies into the lens, fills the frame — she lies in the grass, dust going up, HER EARS NOW BARE like his

must_appear: two animals in frame, muzzles touching; a tag in the goat's mouth; her spit on the lens and in the bucket; dust from the fall; her ears BARE at the end
negative_prompt: tags or a collar on the goat's ears, any letters, cyrillic or logos, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, a held macro with nothing moving, props hovering motionless, a second alpaca, slow motion, speed ramp, the alpaca standing still, silence in the tail, accented Russian
